PLAN THE WORK

Tell us what needs attention.

Describe the fitting or pipe affected, when you noticed the issue and whether water is currently escaping. A photograph of the area can help explain the job, especially for replacement taps, toilets or sink connections.

For planned work, share the fitting you are considering and whether you want to keep the same position. Changing the layout of a kitchen or bathroom can mean changing both supply and waste pipes.

Availability is confirmed for each enquiry. If water is escaping and you can safely isolate its supply, do so and seek prompt help; do not wait for a website enquiry to be read.
